def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    best_node = None
    best_cost = np.inf
    for candidate in unvisited_nodes:
        dist = distance_matrix[current_node, candidate]
        # Exclude candidate from the set when computing standard deviation
        others = unvisited_nodes[unvisited_nodes != candidate]
        if len(others) > 0:
            std = np.std(distance_matrix[candidate, others])
        else:
            std = 0.0
        cost = dist + std
        if cost < best_cost:
            best_cost = cost
            best_node = candidate
    return best_node

algorithm: The next node is selected as the unvisited node minimizing the product of its distance from the current node and its distance to the destination, divided by its average distance to all other unvisited nodes, to favor nodes that are close and well-positioned for the return.
code:
def select_next_node(current_node: int, destination_node: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray, distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
    """Select the next node to visit in a TSP greedy construction.

    Args:
        current_node: ID of the current node
        destination_node: ID of the destination (return) node
        unvisited_nodes: array of unvisited node IDs
        distance_matrix: pairwise distance matrix between all nodes
    Returns:
        next_node: ID of the next node to visit
    """
    if len(unvisited_nodes) == 1:
        return unvisited_nodes[0]

    # distances from current node to each unvisited node
    curr_dists = distance_matrix[current_node, unvisited_nodes]
    # distances from each unvisited node to the destination
    dest_dists = distance_matrix[destination_node, unvisited_nodes]

    # compute average distance from each unvisited node to all other unvisited nodes
    n = len(unvisited_nodes)
    submat = distance_matrix[np.ix_(unvisited_nodes, unvisited_nodes)]
    row_sums = submat.sum(axis=1)  # sum includes 0 for self, so effectively sum to others
    mean_other = row_sums / (n - 1)

    eps = 1e-8
    scores = (curr_dists * dest_dists) / (mean_other + eps)
    best_idx = np.argmin(scores)
    return unvisited_nodes[best_idx]
